brief: Board surface options for the round-05 layout, each in the busiest state: your bishop on c4 is selected (blue = legal squares) while both snails and their next squares (coral) are on the board.

candidates.name: Whisper hatch
candidates.concept: Keeps the Really Bad Chess hatch, but finer, wider-spaced and at 18% ink so it reads as texture, not stripes.

candidates.name: Paper grey
candidates.concept: Flat white and a soft neutral grey. The quietest option; snails and moves do all the talking.

candidates.name: Dot grid
candidates.concept: Dark squares carry a sparse dot pattern instead of lines: still printed-paper texture, far less movement.

candidates.name: Warm stone
candidates.concept: Cream and pebble: warmer, still neutral enough that coral and blue pop.

candidates.name: Cool slate
candidates.concept: Blue-grey board; legal moves switch to a brighter cyan-blue so they still stand apart.

candidates.name: Sage
candidates.concept: A muted green board in the chess.com spirit, desaturated so it never fights the coral.

candidates.name: Ink outline
candidates.concept: All squares white; dark squares are marked by a thin inner frame only. Maximum calm, most Gage-like.
